These health differences may include: How many people get certain diseases How severe the diseases are How many people have complications because of the diseases How many people die from a disease Whether people can get health care How many people get screened for a disease These groups of people may be based on: Race Ethnicity Immigrant status Disability Sex or gender Sexual orientation Geography Income Level of education NIH: National Institute on Minority Health and Health Disparities Start Here Health Equity in Healthy People 2030 (Department of Health and Human Services) Understanding Influences of Sex and Gender in Health and Disease (National Institutes of Health, Office of Research on Women's Health) Specifics Cancer Health Disparities Definitions and Examples (National Cancer Institute) Disparities in the Impact of Air Pollution (American Lung Association) Health Disparities in HIV, Viral Hepatitis, STDs, and Tuberculosis (Centers for Disease Control and Prevention) Health Disparities in Oral Health (Centers for Disease Control and Prevention) LGBT -- Healthy People 2030 (Department of Health and Human Services) Neglected Diseases (National Human Genome Research Institute) Rural Health Disparities (Rural Health Information Hub) The Truth About African American Women and Heart Disease (National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute) -
